hero.headline: Make it
hero.description: From photo mugs and kitchen accessories to apparel and keepsakes - Gravurtastisch turns your artwork into finished pieces with digital proofs, studio-grade engraving, and dependable delivery.

valueProp.description: Every gift and everyday item should carry meaning. Gravurtastisch pairs careful materials with laser-sharp detail - so your photos, names, and messages look premium long after unboxing.
valueProp.feature1Body: Photo cups, cutting boards, textiles, and more - submit once and we route your job to the right craft line without juggling vendors.
valueProp.feature2Body: Every order gets a free digital mockup. Approve layout, fonts, and placement before anything enters the engraver.
valueProp.feature3Body: Track proof, production, and shipment from one place - no chasing email threads for updates.
valueProp.feature4Body: Uploads are encrypted in transit and stored only for fulfillment. Your artwork stays yours.

howItWorks.heading: Send design → proof → craft → deliver.
howItWorks.description: Four clear steps from your artwork to a finished piece on the doorstep. We keep you in the loop at every stage - especially before anything is engraved.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Upload photos, logos, or text. Tell us the product, quantity, and any placement notes.
howItWorks.step2Desc: We mock up layout on the real product shape. You approve - or request tweaks - before production.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Laser engraving, printing, or stitching runs on studio-calibrated equipment with a quality check.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Finished pieces are packed with care and shipped with tracking straight to you or your customer.
howItWorks.ganttSubtitle: From upload to doorstep - proof is the gate before craft.
howItWorks.calloutBody: We never start laser or print work until you approve the digital proof. That single checkpoint protects your brand and your budget.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.para1: Gravurtastisch ("we", "us", or "our"), operated by Ctas Info Services, respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you use our website and custom order services, and how we use it.
privacy.list1Item1: Contact and account details you submit (name, email, phone, business or event name).
privacy.list1Item2: Order details, product choices, and artwork files needed to fulfill custom work.
privacy.list1Item3: Usage data such as pages visited and form submissions on this site.
privacy.list2Item1: To respond to order inquiries and produce approved custom goods.
privacy.list2Item2: To send proofs, production updates, and shipping notifications.
privacy.list2Item3: To respond to support and sales inquiries.
privacy.list2Item4: To improve security, reliability, and the experience of our services.
privacy.para3: Design uploads are collected through secure channels for fulfillment only. We do not publish your artwork in public galleries without permission. Files are retained only as long as needed for production, support, and legal obligations.
privacy.para4: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with shipping carriers, payment processors, and infrastructure providers that help us run the studio, or when required by law.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.para1: By accessing Gravurtastisch or submitting a custom order inquiry, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the site or services.
terms.para1b: Gravurtastisch provides personalized products including photo cups, engraved goods, apparel, and related items. Pricing, turnaround, and features depend on your plan or quoted agreement.
terms.list1Item1: Provide accurate contact and shipping information.
terms.list1Item2: Confirm you have rights to upload logos, photos, and artwork provided for production.
terms.list1Item3: Review and approve digital proofs carefully before production begins.
terms.list1Item4: Use our services only for lawful purposes and acceptable content.
terms.para3: Submitting an inquiry does not guarantee immediate production. We may decline orders that violate content policies, exceed capacity, or appear fraudulent.
terms.para4: Production starts after digital proof approval. Approved layouts are treated as final for engraving and print placement; post-approval changes may incur fees.
terms.para5: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Gravurtastisch and Ctas Info Services are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the service, including delays caused by carriers or incorrect customer-supplied artwork after proof approval.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.para1: This Refund Policy explains how cancellations and refunds work for Gravurtastisch paid plans and custom orders.
refund.para1b: Starter and Growth studio plans are billed monthly in USD. You may cancel anytime; access continues through the end of the current billing period.
refund.list1Item1: If you were charged in error, contact us within 7 days and we will review the charge.
refund.list1Item2: Custom goods in production or shipped after proof approval are generally non-refundable except for verified defects.
refund.list1Item3: Custom Scale and enterprise quotes follow the terms agreed in your proposal or invoice.
refund.para3Suffix: with your account email, order reference, and reason for the request. We typically respond within one business day.

amazonSpApi.heroDesc: Secure connections to your storefronts and order sources. No scattered files, no mystery vendors - just a certified pipeline from upload to shipped parcel.
amazonSpApi.badgeCertifiedDesc: Proof-gated workflows and material profiles built for repeat brand quality.
amazonSpApi.badgeZeroCredDesc: We never ask for your shop password. Connections use OAuth tokens where supported.
amazonSpApi.badgeScopedDesc: Access is limited to order and catalog sync - revoke anytime from your platform.
amazonSpApi.badgeVaultDesc: Artwork and tokens encrypted at rest with industry-standard algorithms.
amazonSpApi.archDesc: Every layer is decoupled and isolated. Assets and credentials live in encrypted enclaves; production traffic is throttled to protect quality SLAs.
amazonSpApi.archFeature1Desc: Every integration call is authenticated with time-limited tokens and audit logging.
amazonSpApi.archFeature2Desc: Store tokens stay isolated from public web endpoints and customer-facing uploads.
amazonSpApi.archLayer3Sub: Smooths peak loads without missed SLAs
amazonSpApi.archLayer4Sub: Live status from intake through shipment
amazonSpApi.endpointsDesc: Gravurtastisch integrates with common commerce APIs and webhooks - we do not scrape private admin panels.
amazonSpApi.endpoint1Purpose: Ingest new custom orders and line items as soon as your storefront confirms checkout.
amazonSpApi.endpoint2Purpose: Maps SKUs to product lines - cups, engrave surfaces, textiles - for correct routing.
amazonSpApi.endpoint3Purpose: Push tracking numbers and carrier events back to your channel when parcels leave the studio.
amazonSpApi.endpoint4Purpose: Separate queues per brand or region while sharing one proof and production engine.
amazonSpApi.comparisonHeading: Why a unified studio hub beats DIY vendors
amazonSpApi.comparisonDesc: Compare Gravurtastisch integrations with risky manual workflows.
amazonSpApi.compRow2Scraping: Files in inboxes and chat apps
amazonSpApi.compRow3RS: Saved presets per SKU and color
amazonSpApi.faqDesc: Clear answers on connections, data security, proofs, and file handling.
amazonSpApi.faqSupportDesc: Our team helps with storefront onboarding.
amazonSpApi.faq1Q: How does Gravurtastisch connect to my shop?
amazonSpApi.faq1A: Where your platform supports OAuth or API tokens, you authorize Gravurtastisch with scoped permissions. We never see your shop password.
amazonSpApi.faq2A: Production unlocks only after you approve the digital proof. That gate is our primary guard against wrong placement, crops, or colors.
amazonSpApi.faq3A: Order references, SKU mappings, shipping addresses, and artwork files required to fulfill - not your unrelated financial or customer marketing lists.
amazonSpApi.faq4Q: Can I revoke access at any time?
amazonSpApi.faq4A: Yes. Disconnect the integration from your commerce admin or contact us to rotate tokens and pause sync.
amazonSpApi.ctaDesc: Proof-first custom production with secure integrations and studio-grade craft.

orderSync.heroDesc: New orders from your connected channels flow into Gravurtastisch automatically. Track every job from proof to shipment without CSV babysitting.
orderSync.bentoSectionHeading: Built to protect your brand timeline
orderSync.bentoSectionDesc: Gravurtastisch sync does not just copy order numbers - it validates SKUs, flags missing artwork, and respects proof holds before production.
orderSync.bentoCard1Desc: Orders appear in your queue within minutes of checkout on connected storefronts - no manual exports.
orderSync.bentoCap1Desc: If a customer cancels or a chargeback opens, production holds trigger automatically.
orderSync.bentoCap2Desc: Route SKUs to the right craft line and default proof templates per product.
orderSync.bentoCap3Desc: DTC, marketplace, and wholesale orders share one proof-first pipeline.
orderSync.pipelineDesc: See how a sale becomes a proof, then a finished personalized product.
orderSync.step1Desc: Customer checks out on your storefront. Line items and shipping details sync to Gravurtastisch.
orderSync.step2Desc: Personalization fields and uploads bind to the order - or flag missing assets for your team.
orderSync.step3Desc: We verify SKU mapping, quantity limits, and content policy before sending a mockup.
orderSync.step4Desc: After proof approval, the job enters the craft schedule with estimated ship date.
orderSync.tableDesc: Inside your dashboard: incoming orders, proof status, production lane, and tracking - in one table.
orderSync.tableBullet1: Automatic timezone alignment on ship estimates
orderSync.tableBullet2: Instant hold on cancelled or disputed orders
orderSync.tableBullet3: One-click reopen proof for artwork fixes
orderSync.faqDesc: Everything you need to know about channel sync, artwork binding, and production holds.
orderSync.faqSupportDesc: Our team assists with storefront pipelines.
orderSync.faq1Q: How often does Gravurtastisch sync orders?
orderSync.faq1A: We use webhooks where available and high-frequency polling otherwise so your queue stays current within minutes.
orderSync.faq2Q: Does sync support both marketplace and direct stores?
orderSync.faq2A: Yes - connect the channels you sell on; all eligible custom SKUs land in the same studio hub.
orderSync.faq3Q: What happens if a buyer cancels after ordering?
orderSync.faq3A: Cancellation events suppress production and alert your team if a proof was already in progress.
orderSync.faq4Q: Can I exclude certain SKUs from auto-import?
orderSync.faq4A: Yes. Configure inclusion and exclusion rules so only personalized lines enter the craft queue.
orderSync.ctaHeading: Put custom order sync on autopilot
orderSync.ctaDesc: No CSVs, no lost personalization fields, no engraving before proof approval.

smartScheduling.heroDesc: Balance proof SLAs, craft capacity, and carrier cutoffs - so personalized orders arrive when you promised, not when chaos allows.
smartScheduling.matrixDesc: Rushing engraving before proof approval wastes material; delaying shipment misses gifting moments. Smart scheduling balances both.
smartScheduling.quad1Desc: Production slots open only after digital approval - automatic holds if proof expires unapproved.
smartScheduling.quad2Desc: Proof emails and nudges timed for when your team actually reads inbox - not 3 AM server time.
smartScheduling.quad3Desc: Textiles, ceramic, and deep wood engrave get different default windows based on real studio throughput.
smartScheduling.quad4Desc: Customers see honest estimates that respect capacity - fewer angry "where is my gift?" messages.
smartScheduling.timelineDesc: How Gravurtastisch sequences proof, craft, and ship for personalized orders.
smartScheduling.phase0Desc: Checkout completes and personalization fields sync to the studio queue.
smartScheduling.phase1Desc: Digital mockup sent. Timer starts for your approval window.
smartScheduling.phase2Desc: Request tweaks without restarting the whole order - version history stays attached.
smartScheduling.phase3Desc: Laser, print, or stitch runs in a reserved slot with QC before pack-out.
smartScheduling.phase4Desc: Carrier pickup aligned to your quoted delivery date and region.
smartScheduling.calloutDesc: When proof approves or parcel ships, statuses flip in your dashboard and optional webhooks fire.
smartScheduling.faqDesc: Answers on proof windows, capacity, holidays, and delivery promises.
smartScheduling.faqSupportDesc: Our team assists with custom SLA rules.
smartScheduling.faq1A: Custom work needs an approved mockup. Starting early would risk wrong text placement, bad crops, or non-refundable material waste.
smartScheduling.faq2Q: Can I set different lead times per product?
smartScheduling.faq2A: Yes - configure defaults per product line or SKU so ship estimates match real craft duration.
smartScheduling.faq3Q: How do you handle holiday peaks?
smartScheduling.faq3A: Capacity rules tighten automatically and we surface honest cutoffs on checkout integrations where supported.
smartScheduling.faq4Q: Can the same order get double-produced?
smartScheduling.faq4A: No. Idempotent job IDs prevent duplicate engrave runs if a webhook retries.
smartScheduling.ctaDesc: Proof-first scheduling with studio-realistic ship dates.

reviewAnalytics.heroDesc: Turn production data into smarter reordering. Track proof turnaround, line utilization, and channel mix - not guesswork.
reviewAnalytics.featureSectionHeading: Understand what drives your custom business
reviewAnalytics.featureSectionDesc: Go beyond order counts. Gravurtastisch shows which SKUs earn reorders, which channels spike seasonally, and where proof cycles slow you down.
reviewAnalytics.feat1Desc: See which product lines ship fastest and which attract the most revision rounds - fix templates before peak season.
reviewAnalytics.feat2Desc: Compare weekly production volume and SLA adherence across quarters.
reviewAnalytics.feat3Desc: Funnel analytics from order intake through proof, production, QC, and delivery.
reviewAnalytics.feat4Desc: Compare mix and margin-friendly volume across DTC, marketplace, and B2B sources.
reviewAnalytics.skuTableDesc: Track proof cycles, production time, and reorder rate per SKU in near real time.
reviewAnalytics.faqDesc: Everything you need to know about studio metrics, exports, and data privacy.
reviewAnalytics.faqSupportDesc: Our team assists with cohort exports.
reviewAnalytics.faq1Q: Does Gravurtastisch share my customer PII in analytics?
reviewAnalytics.faq1A: Reports focus on aggregate order and production metrics. Personal data stays scoped to fulfillment needs.
reviewAnalytics.faq2A: We compare promised ship dates to actual carrier handoffs per product line and channel.
reviewAnalytics.faq3Q: How can insights improve my catalog?
reviewAnalytics.faq3A: Spot SKUs with heavy revision loads - often a template or upload guideline issue - before you scale ads or gifting campaigns.
reviewAnalytics.faq4A: Yes. CSV and PDF exports are available from the dashboard for ops and finance teams.
reviewAnalytics.ctaDesc: See proof, production, and delivery data in one place - grow your custom brand with confidence.
